build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a slanted obstacle and a ball in a physics scene
create_static_bar_obstacle: create a static bar obstacle with a configurable angle and position in the PHYRE scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned at a specific x coordinate and height in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task goal to require the ball touching the bottom wall using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_meta: set the task metadata to mark it as a SINGLE_OBJECT solution tier
